sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访多位在商业、政治和文化领域极具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月

sentences.en: 18th.
sentences.zh: 18日在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》App 来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I got an email that said, let me find it and read it to you.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一封邮件，上面写着——让我找出来读给你听。

sentences.en: The heading is attendance required, all in capitals, two exclamation points, WW business update meeting.
sentences.zh: 主题是“必须出席”，全大写，两个感叹号，“WW 业务更新会议”。

sentences.en: Okay, so this is what the email says.
sentences.zh: 好的，邮件内容是这样的。

sentences.en: Please join your territory manager for an important business update tomorrow, Thursday, May 14th at 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 请于明天（5月14日星期四）下午4点

sentences.en: Eastern, 3 p.m.
sentences.zh: （美东时间）下午3点

sentences.en: Central via an audio-only conference call.
sentences.zh: （中部时间），通过纯音频电话会议，加入您的区域经理召开的重要业务更新会议。

sentences.en: It is important that you make yourself available to attend this meeting.
sentences.zh: 请务必抽出时间参加这次会议。

sentences.en: And then it says, thank you in advance for your attendance, WW field management team.
sentences.zh: 最后写着，预先感谢您的出席，WW 现场管理团队。

sentences.en: So I worked my regular shift, dialed in at three o'clock.
sentences.zh: 所以我像往常一样上班，在三点钟拨入了电话。

sentences.en: The territory manager reading from a script essentially said
sentences.zh: 区域经理照着稿子念，大意是说

sentences.en: that they're restructuring the company based on changes that needed to be made for business decision reasons.
sentences.zh: 由于业务决策原因需要做出调整，公司正在进行重组。

sentences.en: And that at the end of that call, I would no longer be employed by the company and click.
sentences.zh: 通话结束时，我将不再受雇于该公司，然后挂断。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: Three-minute phone call.
sentences.zh: 三分钟的电话。

sentences.en: And I just, I started crying.
sentences.zh: 然后我，我开始哭泣。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我是说，

sentences.en: I've been with the company 18 years.
sentences.zh: 我在公司干了18年。

sentences.en: We were fired in a three-minute call where we were muted.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个被全员禁言的三分钟电话里被解雇了。

sentences.en: We weren't given any information.
sentences.zh: 我们没有得到任何信息。

sentences.en: We were not treated with any empathy.
sentences.zh: 我们没有受到任何同理心的对待。

sentences.en: We were not treated with any caring.
sentences.zh: 我们没有受到任何关怀的对待。

sentences.en: We weren't, you know, told how important we were to the company.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们没有告诉我们对公司有多重要。

sentences.en: We weren't thanked for our many years of service.
sentences.zh: 他们没有感谢我们多年的服务。

sentences.en: We were just told, you're not important.
sentences.zh: 他们只是告诉我们，你并不重要。

sentences.en: We don't care.
sentences.zh: 我们不在乎。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Three months after mass layoffs began across the U.S., 20 million Americans remain out of work because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在美国各地大规模裁员开始三个月后，2000万美国人因疫情失业。

sentences.en: Federal unemployment benefits are about to run out.
sentences.zh: 联邦失业救济金即将耗尽。

sentences.en: And Congress can't agree on a new package of financial help.
sentences.zh: 而国会无法就一揽子新的经济援助计划达成一致。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues speak to laid-off workers about the state of their unemployment.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事将与被裁员工交流他们目前的失业状况。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月24日星期三。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Nicole Nordman.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫妮可·诺德曼。

sentences.en: I am 53 years old.
sentences.zh: 我今年53岁。

sentences.en: I live in Homewood, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 我住在伊利诺伊州霍姆伍德。

sentences.en: It's a suburb of
sentences.zh: 那是芝加哥的一个郊区，

sentences.en: Chicago, about 35 miles south of Chicago.
sentences.zh: 在芝加哥以南约35英里处。

sentences.en: I actually have a juris doctorate, so I was a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 其实我有法律博士学位，所以我曾是一名律师。

sentences.en: But I stopped working full-time back in 1993 because my daughter was born with an illness called cystic
sentences.zh: 但在1993年我停止了全职工作，因为我的女儿生病了，患有一种叫作囊性

sentences.en: fibrosis, which is a genetic disease which causes a lot of complications to the lungs.
sentences.zh: 纤维化的疾病，这是一种会导致许多肺部并发症的遗传病。

sentences.en: And she needed a lot of care for her first several years.
sentences.zh: 在她最初的几年里，她需要大量的照料。

sentences.en: And I decided that rather than paying a nurse and a babysitter, I would stop working and stay home with her.
sentences.zh: 我决定与其花钱请护士和保姆，不如辞职回家照顾她。

sentences.en: So all my degrees kind of just fell to the wayside, and I ended up staying at home with her.
sentences.zh: 所以我的学位就这样被搁置了，最后我选择在家照顾她。

sentences.en: And can you tell me, where were you working most recently?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我，你最近在哪里工作吗？

sentences.en: I was employed by Weight Watchers for the last 18 years.
sentences.zh: 我在慧优体（Weight Watchers）工作了过去的18年。

sentences.en: I had started out part-time.
sentences.zh: 我最初是做兼职的。

sentences.en: Once she
sentences.zh: 等她

sentences.en: got older and got that lung transplant, I went to work for them full-time, and I had been working for them full-time for almost seven years now.
sentences.zh: 长大并做了肺移植手术后，我开始为他们全职工作，到现在全职工作快七年了。

sentences.en: Can you talk to me, what was Weight Watchers providing in terms of benefits or financial help or payments after the firings?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我谈谈吗，在解雇之后，慧优体在福利、经济援助或补偿金方面提供了什么？

sentences.en: They paid us for a week after, an extra week, and they're giving us a lifetime membership for Weight Watchers.
sentences.zh: 他们在之后给我们发了一周的工资，即额外的一周，并给了我们慧优体的终身会员资格。

sentences.en: I guess that's about it.
sentences.zh: 我想也就这些了。

sentences.en: Healthcare benefits?
sentences.zh: 医疗福利呢？

sentences.en: Any sort of retirement?
sentences.zh: 任何形式的退休金？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I'm hoping that I'm going to get unemployment.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能领到失业救济金。

sentences.en: I've applied.
sentences.zh: 我申请了。

sentences.en: I have not gotten anything yet.
sentences.zh: 我还没拿到任何东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, if I get the unemployment, I'll be okay until they cut out that extra money at the end of July.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，如果我能拿到失业救济金，在7月底他们取消那笔额外资金之前，我还能应付过去。

sentences.en: But after that, you know, I can't really live on $250 a week, so I'm going to have a big problem.
sentences.zh: 但那之后，你知道的，我真的靠每周250美元过不下去，所以我会遇到大麻烦。

sentences.en: You know, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不知道。

sentences.en: You know, I'm going to have to find another job, and I'm 53 years old and have worked for the same company for 18 years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我得找另一份工作，而我53岁了，在同一家公司工作了18年。

sentences.en: And, you know, yes, I have several college degrees, but I've never used any of them because, you know, or it's been a long time since I've used any of them, let's say.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我有几个大学学位，但我从来没用过它们，因为，你知道，或者说我已经很久没用过它们了。

sentences.en: So, you know, going back and using any of them is next to impossible.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，回去使用它们中的任何一个简直是不可能的。

sentences.en: It's been,
sentences.zh: 已经，

sentences.en: you know, 26 years since, she's 27, so 27 years since I've used any of them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，26年了，她已经27岁了，所以从我用过这些学位到现在已经27年了。

sentences.en: So, I don't know what
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道

sentences.en: I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: 我要怎么办。

sentences.en: I really don't.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: I think about that every night.
sentences.zh: 我每天晚上都在想这个。

sentences.en: I don't think I've gotten a full night's sleep in three weeks.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我已经三周没睡过一个完整的觉了。

sentences.en: I fall asleep at three in the morning, and then I'm back up at seven wondering the same things.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨三点入睡，然后七点又醒来，脑子里想着同样的事情。

sentences.en: And some days I think, okay, it's going to work out somehow, and then I move on.
sentences.zh: 有时候我想，好吧，总会有办法解决的，然后我就继续过日子。

sentences.en: And then the next night, it's, it's not, not so good.
sentences.zh: 但到了第二天晚上，情况就，就没那么美妙了。

sentences.en: But I mean, I know that there's, what, several, several million people in the country going through exactly the same thing as me.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，我知道全国有，什么，好几百万人的处境和我完全一样。

sentences.en: I know it's a little early, but have there been any silver linings?
sentences.zh: 我知道现在说这个可能有点早，但有什么积极的一面吗？

sentences.en: I just, I guess, you know, I am stronger than I thought I was.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我想，你知道，我比自己想象的要坚强。

sentences.en: I didn't let this, you know, push me back into a depression or anxiety spiral, even though, you know, I am having some sleep issues.
sentences.zh: 我没有让这件事，你知道，把我推回抑郁或焦虑的漩涡中，尽管，你知道，我确实有一些睡眠问题。

sentences.en: It's nothing like what it was, you know, seven years ago before my daughter's transplant.
sentences.zh: 这跟七年前我女儿移植手术前的情况完全没法比。

sentences.en: And I'm not going to let
sentences.zh: 我不会让

sentences.en: them, you know, take away the strength that I've gained over the last seven years.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道，夺走我在过去七年里获得的力量。

sentences.en: I'm not going to let them destroy that.
sentences.zh: 我不会让他们摧毁这些。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Nicole.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，妮可。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I appreciate you doing this.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你接受采访。

sentences.en: Hi, is this Analia?
sentences.zh: 喂，请问是阿娜莉亚吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hi, Analia.
sentences.zh: 你好，阿娜莉亚。

sentences.en: This is Sabrina Tavernisi from the New York Times calling.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布里纳·塔韦尼西。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you today?
sentences.zh: 你好，今天过得怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 我还好。

sentences.en: I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 我还好。

sentences.en: Thanks for taking the time to talk with me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你花时间和我交谈。

sentences.en: So Analia, I want to go back to the beginning when you first lost your job and what happened.
sentences.zh: 阿娜莉亚，我想回到最初你刚失去工作的时候，看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: My name is Analia Rodriguez.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿娜莉亚·罗德里格斯。

sentences.en: I'm 45 years old.
sentences.zh: 我今年45岁。

sentences.en: I was working at the airport in Fort
sentences.zh: 我曾在劳雷托堡

sentences.en: Loretto as a bartender.
sentences.zh: 机场的一家酒吧当调酒师。

sentences.en: And I got laid off on March the 20th.
sentences.zh: 我在3月20日被解雇了。

sentences.en: What was that day like?
sentences.zh: 那天是什么样的？

sentences.en: How did you find out?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么发现的？

sentences.en: I was scheduled to go to work.
sentences.zh: 我原本排了班要去上班。

sentences.en: And I received a phone call telling me not to go,
sentences.zh: 然后我接到一个电话，叫我不要去了，

sentences.en: that they were like closing.
sentences.zh: 说他们要关门了之类的。

sentences.en: And later on, I got a letter on the mail.
sentences.zh: 后来，我在信箱里收到了一封信。

sentences.en: So yeah, it was devastating.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这太具毁灭性了。

sentences.en: It was really bad.
sentences.zh: 真的太糟糕了。

sentences.en: The type of news is something that you don't want to hear.
sentences.zh: 这种新闻是你不想听到的。

sentences.en: It's nothing that we expect, especially when we have the health insurance benefits.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们所期望的，尤其是当我们还指望着医疗保险福利的时候。

sentences.en: And, you know, in my case, is a muSt. Why is it a must for you?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在我的情况下，这是必不可少的。为什么这对你来说必不可少？

sentences.en: Well, my husband had an accident last year.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我丈夫去年出了事故。

sentences.en: He was riding his motorcycle and he had an accident.
sentences.zh: 他骑摩托车时出了事故。

sentences.en: He's suffering from a brain injury.
sentences.zh: 他患有脑损伤。

sentences.en: And he also lost his leg.
sentences.zh: 而且他还失去了一条腿。

sentences.en: So for me, keeping my health insurance,
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，保留医疗保险，

sentences.en: I was so important.
sentences.zh: 真的非常重要。

sentences.en: I worked really hard just because I wanted to be able to take care of him.
sentences.zh: 我拼命工作，只是因为我想有能力照顾他。

sentences.en: So, yep.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: Now this happened.
sentences.zh: 现在事情发生了。

sentences.en: So once again, we are starting from scratch.
sentences.zh: 所以我们又一次从零开始。

sentences.en: So you were laid off on March 20th.
sentences.zh: 所以你在3月20日被解雇了。

sentences.en: And then what happened?
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么？

sentences.en: What did you do?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: I applied for the unemployment online.
sentences.zh: 我在网上申请了失业救济。

sentences.en: I mean, it was very hard.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这非常难。

sentences.en: It was so much traffic, which is very understandable.
sentences.zh: 访问量太大了，这也是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: I'm not the only one here.
sentences.zh: 我不是唯一的一个。

sentences.en: There's hundreds of people that are trying to get through it.
sentences.zh: 有成百上千的人都在试图挤进去。

sentences.en: I woke up at two o'clock, at four o'clock, six o'clock, seven o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我在两点、四点、六点、七点醒来。

sentences.en: And it was impossible.
sentences.zh: 但根本不可能。

sentences.en: You're trying to apply, you get to a certain point, and then it kick you out of the website.
sentences.zh: 你尝试申请，进行到某一步，然后网站就把你踢出来了。

sentences.en: And it doesn't even save your information.
sentences.zh: 而且它甚至不保存你的信息。

sentences.en: How many times did you try on the website?
sentences.zh: 你在官网上试了多少次？

sentences.en: Do you remember, roughly?
sentences.zh: 你还记得大致的数字吗？

sentences.en: In the beginning, it was every day, every, you know, every hour, like different hours.
sentences.zh: 一开始，是每天，每一个，你知道，每一个小时，不同的时间段。

sentences.en: I will take different hours in the day to try to get through it.
sentences.zh: 我会挑一天中不同的时间去尝试登录。

sentences.en: I called customer service.
sentences.zh: 我打了客服电话。

sentences.en: Like today, before, you know, this interview, I tried seven times to call to see what's going on.
sentences.zh: 就像今天一样，在这场采访之前，你知道的，我打了七次电话想看看是怎么回事。

sentences.en: And finally, I got someone to help me today.
sentences.zh: 最后，今天我终于找到人帮我了。

sentences.en: And fair enough, she didn't know anything.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，她什么都不知道。

sentences.en: Like, she couldn't help me.
sentences.zh: 就好像，她根本帮不了我。

sentences.en: I mean, I need the money.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我需要钱。

sentences.en: I really need it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很需要钱。

sentences.en: We are struggling really bad.
sentences.zh: 我们的日子过得非常艰难。

sentences.en: And Aaliyah, how are you guys doing for food?
sentences.zh: 阿莉亚，你们现在的伙食怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, we have a food distribution, you know, so you have to go in a car and you have to make the line.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们有食品发放点，你知道的，所以你得开车去排队。

sentences.en: What is the line like?
sentences.zh: 排队情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: The lines are like, pretty long.
sentences.zh: 队伍排得挺长的。

sentences.en: Even though if you go early, you have to wait in the car for so long.
sentences.zh: 哪怕你去得很早，你也得在车里等好久。

sentences.en: It's embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 这太尴尬了。

sentences.en: No, because I'm like, I'm not doing anything that I'm not supposed to do.
sentences.zh: 不，因为我觉得，我没有做任何不该做的事。

sentences.en: It's embarrassing for me as a person after working 20 years, coming to this country.
sentences.zh: 作为一个工作了20年、来到这个国家的人，这让我感到很丢脸。

sentences.en: And I work really hard to be part of the system.
sentences.zh: 我非常努力地工作，以便融入这个体制。

sentences.en: I came here with a one-year-old son by myself.
sentences.zh: 我当年独自带着一岁的儿子来到这里。

sentences.en: I never applied for any help, anything, because I felt like I could work for it.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有申请过任何援助或别的什么，因为我觉得我可以靠自己工作养活自己。

sentences.en: I don't want free stuff.
sentences.zh: 我不要免费的东西。

sentences.en: I want what is mine.
sentences.zh: 我只想得到属于我自己的东西。

sentences.en: And that's why I'm at this point that it's so embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么到了现在这一步，我会觉得这么难堪。

sentences.en: You have to go and feel like you're begging for money, begging for food.
sentences.zh: 你不得不去，感觉就像在乞讨金钱、乞讨食物。

sentences.en: You know, I have to email my landlord telling him that I'm going to, you know, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不得不给房东发邮件告诉他我要，你知道的，我不知道。

sentences.en: I can even give him an answer.
sentences.zh: 我甚至无法给他一个答复。

sentences.en: Okay, listen, my money is going to come in July and I'm going to pay you everything that I owe.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，我的钱将在七月份到账，我会付清我欠的一切。

sentences.en: No, I don't have an answer because I don't know when my money is going to be coming.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有答案，因为我不知道我的钱什么时候能到账。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it's like, you cannot borrow money from a friend.
sentences.zh: 所以就像是，你根本没法向朋友借钱。

sentences.en: When are you going to pay him back?
sentences.zh: 你打算什么时候还人家？

sentences.en: So I just, I didn't sit home waiting for my money or my checks.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是，我没有坐在家里等钱或支票寄到。

sentences.en: I had to do something because we need to survive.
sentences.zh: 我必须做点什么，因为我们需要生存。

sentences.en: And then I had to sell my car.
sentences.zh: 然后我不得不把车卖了。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: When did you sell your car?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候卖的车？

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那个吧。

sentences.en: Well, because I don't have any income and I can't pay for anything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为我没有任何收入，什么也付不起。

sentences.en: So I was like, okay, you know what?
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，好吧，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to try to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 我打算试着做个交易。

sentences.en: Somebody wants my car.
sentences.zh: 有人想要我的车。

sentences.en: Obviously, they don't give you the money that probably the car is worth.
sentences.zh: 很显然，他们给的钱可能根本不值这辆车原本的价值。

sentences.en: But you know, I could have some money to keep going on.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，我能拿到一些钱维持生计。

sentences.en: And I had to like go to a pound shop and I had to sell my wedding rings.
sentences.zh: 我还不得不去当铺把我的结婚戒指给卖了。

sentences.en: Did you think about it really hard for a long time?
sentences.zh: 你考虑了很久很久吗？

sentences.en: Or how did you think about that decision?
sentences.zh: 或者你是怎么考虑这个决定的？

sentences.en: Well, it took me almost two months to think about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我花了将近两个月的时间来考虑。

sentences.en: That ring for me, it was like an attachment to him, a reminder, you know, he's going to survive.
sentences.zh: 那枚戒指对我来说，就像是对他的寄托、一个回忆，你知道的，他会活下来的。

sentences.en: Remember, you're married to this guy.
sentences.zh: 记住，你嫁给了这个男人。

sentences.en: It had a meaning, you know, for me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这对我有特殊的意义。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So I cried for a few nights.
sentences.zh: 所以我哭了几个晚上。

sentences.en: I couldn't sleep.
sentences.zh: 我彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: But, you know, my family is firSt.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我的家人是第一位的。

sentences.en: And I don't see that the money is going to come anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得钱也不会那么快到账。

sentences.en: I have to do what I have to do.
sentences.zh: 我只能做我必须做的事。

sentences.en: And Aaliyah, thank you for telling me your story.
sentences.zh: 阿莉亚，谢谢你跟我分享你的故事。

sentences.en: Thank you for like listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你愿意倾听。

sentences.en: And I'm sorry if I get like so frustrated, but it is the truth.
sentences.zh: 如果我表现得这么沮丧，我很抱歉，但这都是实话。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Aaliyah.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，阿莉亚。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Subscribe to the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 立即下载时报App，即可免费畅享30天。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Nikita?
sentences.zh: 尼基塔？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Can you hear me now?
sentences.zh: 你现在能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: I can hear you fine.
sentences.zh: 我听得很清楚。

sentences.en: Nikita, thanks so much for doing this.
sentences.zh: 尼基塔，非常感谢你配合采访。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉。

sentences.en: Sorry for all the tech confusion.
sentences.zh: 为刚才所有的技术混乱感到抱歉。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用谢。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Maybe just to start out, tell us who you are.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以先开始，介绍一下你自己。

sentences.en: What's your name?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: How old are you?
sentences.zh: 你多大了？

sentences.en: Where do you live?
sentences.zh: 你住在哪里？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: My name is Nikita Long, and I live in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 我叫尼基塔·朗，我住在北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: I'm 44 years old.
sentences.zh: 我44岁。

sentences.en: Tell me where you were working.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你之前在哪里工作。

sentences.en: What were you doing?
sentences.zh: 你以前是做什么的？

sentences.en: I was working in an automotive manufacturing facility.
sentences.zh: 我曾在一家汽车制造厂工作。

sentences.en: We make airbag centers and parts for all the vehicles that are on the road, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上为路上行驶的所有车辆制造安全气囊中心和零部件。

sentences.en: And I was hired through a temp agency.
sentences.zh: 我是通过一家临时劳务派遣公司被录用的。

sentences.en: So I had been working there almost two years.
sentences.zh: 我在那里工作了将近两年。

sentences.en: And so being hired on permanently was the goal.
sentences.zh: 所以转为正式员工是我的目标。

sentences.en: So it was a temp job, but you were hoping it would become permanent.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一份临时工作，但你希望它能变成正式的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We were continuously getting promised that it would become permanent.
sentences.zh: 公司一直承诺我们会转正。

sentences.en: So we continued to stay and tough it out.
sentences.zh: 所以我们选择继续留下来咬牙坚持。

sentences.en: How did you learn that you were going to lose your job?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么得知自己要失业的？

sentences.en: It was one of my days off.
sentences.zh: 那是我的一天休假。

sentences.en: It was during the weekday.
sentences.zh: 那是工作日中的一天。

sentences.en: My three-year-old was running around.
sentences.zh: 我三岁的孩子正在到处跑。

sentences.en: And I got an email from the temporary office's agent.
sentences.zh: 然后我收到了派遣公司经纪人发的一封邮件。

sentences.en: And she said, you know, I've been trying to reach you.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，我一直联系不上你。

sentences.en: Don't go back to the location.
sentences.zh: 不要再去那个厂区了。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking, what did I do wrong?
sentences.zh: 当时我在想，我做错了什么？

sentences.en: Did I mess up a part?
sentences.zh: 我是把零件弄坏了吗？

sentences.en: What did I do?
sentences.zh: 我到底干了什么？

sentences.en: And so when I called her, she just was like, your job is done.
sentences.zh: 所以当我给她回电话时，她直接就说，你的工作结束了。

sentences.en: Effective immediately.
sentences.zh: 即刻生效。

sentences.en: Do not go back to the plant.
sentences.zh: 不要再回工厂了。

sentences.en: I need your badge.
sentences.zh: 我需要你的工牌。

sentences.en: And I, you know, stopped.
sentences.zh: 然后我，你知道的，愣住了。

sentences.en: I don't really know what I did, but I know I disconnected from the environment.
sentences.zh: 我其实不知道自己做了什么，但我知道我跟那个环境脱节了。

sentences.en: I disconnected from my three-year-old.
sentences.zh: 我跟我三岁的孩子脱节了。

sentences.en: I disconnected from everything.
sentences.zh: 我跟一切都脱节了。

sentences.en: Like, I got to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我得处理这件事。

sentences.en: I have to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 我必须处理这件事。

sentences.en: What is this about?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: What is going on here?
sentences.zh: 这到底在搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: This can't be happening right now because I have never really been able to save for retirement because I got temporary.
sentences.zh: 这种事现在绝不能发生，因为我从来没能存下退休金，就因为我干的是临时工。

sentences.en: The money hasn't really been there.
sentences.zh: 钱其实一直就没到位过。

sentences.en: So I don't have it right now in me to go out here and do this.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在真的没有精力去外面重新应付这一切。

sentences.en: Where's my resume?
sentences.zh: 我的简历在哪？

sentences.en: I got to update my resume.
sentences.zh: 我得更新我的简历。

sentences.en: Oh, my God, I'm too old for this.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，我年纪都这么大了还来这一出。

sentences.en: I don't want to go back out here and do this.
sentences.zh: 我不想再出去受这份罪了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Am I going to be able to find something where I'm going to be able to cater around my three-year-old?
sentences.zh: 我能找到一份既能照顾到我三岁孩子的工作吗？

sentences.en: Am I going to even be able to find a job at all?
sentences.zh: 我甚至还能找到工作吗？

sentences.en: What am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么办？

sentences.en: I just thought about my kids.
sentences.zh: 我满脑子想的都是我的孩子们。

sentences.en: How is my next decision going to affect them?
sentences.zh: 我的下一个决定会如何影响他们？

sentences.en: So it was so many words going through my mind, and I just had to write down, okay, what bills do I have?
sentences.zh: 所以有无数的想法在我脑海中闪过，我只能写下来：好吧，我有什么账单要付？

sentences.en: What can I let go of?
sentences.zh: 我可以放弃什么？

sentences.en: What can I do?
sentences.zh: 我能做些什么？

sentences.en: Because I don't want my kids to be deprived of the life that I've worked so hard to provide for them.
sentences.zh: 因为我不想让我的孩子们失去我费尽心思为他们提供的生活。

sentences.en: I don't want them to suffer through this because of this.
sentences.zh: 我不想让他们因为这件事而遭受痛苦。

sentences.en: How do I keep the atmosphere still positive, still optimistic for them when I'm going crazy inside, like, oh, my God, what does this mean?
sentences.zh: 当我的内心快要崩溃，满脑子都是“天哪，这意味着什么”的时候，我该如何为他们保持一种积极、乐观的氛围？

sentences.en: All of these things were going through my head.
sentences.zh: 所有这些念头都在我脑海里翻江倒海。

sentences.en: I was just in chaos.
sentences.zh: 我当时简直一团糟。

sentences.en: That's a lot of thoughts all at once.
sentences.zh: 一下子涌现出这么多想法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And even as you were thinking about all of that, you were thinking about protecting your kids and not letting them see what you were dealing with.
sentences.zh: 甚至在你想着所有这些事情的时候，你还在想着保护你的孩子们，不让他们看到你所经历的这一切。

sentences.en: I wanted to make sure that I maintained the environment where they felt like, Mom, she's going to figure it out again.
sentences.zh: 我想确保我能维持那样一个环境，让他们觉得：妈妈，她会搞定一切的。

sentences.en: She always does.
sentences.zh: 她总是能做到。

sentences.en: Mom always gets it right.
sentences.zh: 妈妈总是有办法的。

sentences.en: She always makes it right for us.
sentences.zh: 她总能为我们把一切安排妥当。

sentences.en: My daughter's 17.
sentences.zh: 我女儿17岁了。

sentences.en: She's talking about college.
sentences.zh: 她在谈论上大学的事。

sentences.en: She's excited to go away and do all those things, you know, the kids are going to do when they get 18.
sentences.zh: 她很高兴能离家去经历那些孩子们到18岁时都会做的事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: They think the world's an oyster, right?
sentences.zh: 他们觉得世界任由他们驰骋，对吧？

sentences.en: And I was like, OK, how do I how do I let them experience that and still deal with what we're dealing with?
sentences.zh: 当时我在想，好吧，我该怎么，怎么让他们去体验这一切，同时还要应付我们目前的处境？

sentences.en: Had you always been in manufacturing?
sentences.zh: 你一直都在制造业工作吗？

sentences.en: Pretty much.
sentences.zh: 差不多吧。

sentences.en: I had always been in manufacturing the entire time that I was in school because I had kids.
sentences.zh: 从我上学带孩子的那段时期开始，我一直都在制造业工作。

sentences.en: So, you know, I had to juggle that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我不得不两头兼顾。

sentences.en: I did manufacturing, raise my kids and I went to school.
sentences.zh: 我做过制造业，抚养孩子，还上了学。

sentences.en: And so when it came time for me to graduate and be able to use that degree,
sentences.zh: 所以当到了我毕业、能够学以致用的时候，

sentences.en: I was constantly told I was overqualified because I would put the master's degree if it was a great accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 我总是被告知我大材小用了，因为如果把硕士学位写上去的话，这本来是个很棒的成就。

sentences.en: But the employees would say, well, if you have a master's degree,
sentences.zh: 但雇主们会说，好吧，如果你有硕士学位，

sentences.en: what's going to happen is you're going to get here and you're going to realize there's not enough money and you're going to want to leave.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的事会是，你来到这里，然后你会发现钱不够，接着你就会想要离开。

sentences.en: So it was kind of, you know, I couldn't win on either spectrum.
sentences.zh: 所以这就有点像是，你知道的，我在哪个方面都赢不了。

sentences.en: I couldn't really get my foot in the door on any level to do anything because I was either overqualified because of my degree or I was underqualified because I never had any experience in criminal justice.
sentences.zh: 我在任何层面上都很难找到突破口去做任何事，因为要么是因为我有学位而显得大材小用，要么是因为我从来没有刑事司法方面的工作经验而显得资历不足。

sentences.en: You have a master's degree in criminal justice.
sentences.zh: 你拥有刑事司法硕士学位。

sentences.en: What were you what were you planning on doing with that originally?
sentences.zh: 你原本打算用它来做什么？

sentences.en: I originally planned to go on to law school and get my J.D.
sentences.zh: 我原本计划去读法学院，拿到法学博士学位，

sentences.en: and be a judge.
sentences.zh: 然后当一名法官。

sentences.en: But it never quite never quite came out that way.
sentences.zh: 但事情并没有完全按那个方向发展。

sentences.en: No, because life happens, you know, and you have to make adjustments.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为生活总会发生各种事，你知道的，你不得不做出调整。

sentences.en: I'm a single mom for quite, you know, quite some time.
sentences.zh: 我有很长一段时间都是单亲妈妈，你知道的。

sentences.en: So I just got really stuck in that cycle, you know, of having to take care of my family, make ends meet.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的陷入了那个循环中，你知道的，必须照顾我的家人，维持生计。

sentences.en: How much how much did you make in that job?
sentences.zh: 你那份工作赚了多少钱？

sentences.en: We started out when we first got there, 1425, I believe, an hour.
sentences.zh: 我们刚去的时候，开始是，如果我没记错的话，一小时14.25美元。

sentences.en: And then what I ended was 1525.
sentences.zh: 然后我离职时是15.25美元。

sentences.en: And I've been at that for almost a year.
sentences.zh: 我拿着这个薪水已经快一年了。

sentences.en: Was it was that enough for you to get by?
sentences.zh: 这够你应付生活了吗？

sentences.en: It was just enough.
sentences.zh: 勉强够用。

sentences.en: I still had to apply for food stamps.
sentences.zh: 我还是得申请食品券。

sentences.en: So it was not enough, but I made it work because it was better than a lot of other jobs that I had worked, working substantially harder, making substantially less.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不够，但我设法撑了过去，因为它比我做过的许多其他工作要好，那些工作辛苦得多，赚的却少得多。

sentences.en: I mean, I went to school.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我上过学。

sentences.en: I did everything I was supposed to do.
sentences.zh: 我做了我该做的一切。

sentences.en: And I was told I was promised that this was part of the dream for a better life.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，也向我保证过，这是追求更美好生活梦想的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, those those posters that they had up in the schools.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，学校里贴的那些海报。

sentences.en: And I don't know if they have them up anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们现在还在不在学校里贴。

sentences.en: You know, a high school graduate makes this much.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，高中毕业生能赚这么多。

sentences.en: Someone with a master's degree makes this much.
sentences.zh: 有硕士学位的人能赚这么多。

sentences.en: Where is that at?
sentences.zh: 那到底在哪里？

sentences.en: Because I've never seen that.
sentences.zh: 因为我从来没见过。

sentences.en: I've never seen $50,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 我从来没见过一年5万美元。

sentences.en: Once you sort of got through that first wave of emotions and you're sitting there and looking at the money you have and the money that's going to be coming in,
sentences.zh: 当你稍微熬过第一波情绪波动，坐在那里看着你现有的钱和将要到账的钱时，

sentences.en: what decisions did you make?
sentences.zh: 你做出了什么决定？

sentences.en: I lost my job on March 30th.
sentences.zh: 我在3月30日失去了工作。

sentences.en: So this was around tax time.
sentences.zh: 所以这正值报税季前后。

sentences.en: What was able to keep my family inside the home that we have and to keep me from begging, you know, bill collectors from, you know, cutting off my lights, you know,
sentences.zh: 能够让我的家人继续住在我们现在的家里，让我不用去求人，你知道的，不用去求催收账款的人，你知道的，不要切断我的电，你知道的，

sentences.en: cutting off my water, cutting off the gas, was that I was able to tap into my tax refund.
sentences.zh: 不断水，不断燃气，是因为我能够动用我的退税。

sentences.en: And that that was what I was living off of.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是靠这个过日子的。

sentences.en: And I applied for unemployment.
sentences.zh: 我还申请了失业救济。

sentences.en: So I called every day, about 20 times a day, constantly calling back, hang up, car it back, hang up, car it back, nothing, no one.
sentences.zh: 所以我每天都打电话，一天大约打20次，不停地回拨，挂断，回拨，挂断，回拨，什么都没有，没有人接。

sentences.en: So I'm like, okay.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，好吧。

sentences.en: How long did it take to resolve that?
sentences.zh: 解决这件事花了多长时间？

sentences.en: On April 14th, I was able to get a resolution and it said that my claim had been approved $223 a week after all my time working.
sentences.zh: 在4月14日，我终于得到了一个解决方案，上面说我的申请已经通过了，在我工作了那么久之后，每周发放223美元。

sentences.en: And the additional $600 from the federal government was the amount that I was able to stay my bills because, you know, I don't know who can live off $223 a week.
sentences.zh: 再加上联邦政府提供的600美元，这就是我能够支付账单的金额，因为，你知道的，我不知道有谁能靠每周223美元生活。

sentences.en: I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定。

sentences.en: You're getting $600 a week from the federal government.
sentences.zh: 你每周从联邦政府领600美元。

sentences.en: You're getting $223 from the state of North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 你从北卡罗来纳州领223美元。

sentences.en: How does that compare to what you were earning when you were working back at the plant?
sentences.zh: 这和你以前在工厂工作时的收入相比怎么样？

sentences.en: It is actually more than I was earning.
sentences.zh: 这其实比我赚的还要多。

sentences.en: And I think that's probably the sad part about it, that it is actually more.
sentences.zh: 我想这大概是其中最悲哀的部分，它居然真的更多。

sentences.en: I'm bringing in now $300, a little bit over $320 more.
sentences.zh: 我现在拿到手的钱多了300美元，比我每天去上班时多出320多一点。

sentences.en: I mean, give or take a few dollars that I was making going to work every day.
sentences.zh: 我是说，跟去上班每天赚的钱相比，上下只差几美元。

sentences.en: So it's allowed me to pay my bills a little bit more comfortably.
sentences.zh: 所以这让我能够稍微更从容地支付账单了。

sentences.en: You say it's sort of sad that you're making more on unemployment than you were working.
sentences.zh: 你说，靠失业救济赚的钱比上班时还多，这有点悲哀。

sentences.en: Why do you say that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么这么说？

sentences.en: Why do you say that's sad?
sentences.zh: 你为什么说这很悲哀？

sentences.en: That I have to make a decision between working and making less and staying home and making more when I'd rather be working.
sentences.zh: 因为当我宁愿去工作时，却必须在工作但赚得少和呆在家里但赚得多之间做出选择。

sentences.en: Why can that not be included in salaries?
sentences.zh: 为什么这不能算在薪水里？

sentences.en: Why can that not be included in wages?
sentences.zh: 为什么这不能算在工资里？

sentences.en: I love to work.
sentences.zh: 我热爱工作。

sentences.en: I want to contribute to society.
sentences.zh: 我想为社会做贡献。

sentences.en: Be with my peers.
sentences.zh: 和我的同龄人在一起。

sentences.en: I want to, you know, meet people at work.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，在工作结识不同的人。

sentences.en: They're different from me.
sentences.zh: 他们跟我不同。

sentences.en: I want to get out the house away from my family.
sentences.zh: 我想离开家，离开我的家人。

sentences.en: We all want that right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在都想要这个。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But, you know, I want to, I want to contribute to society.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我想，我想为社会做贡献。

sentences.en: I mean, don't, I don't know, maybe it's me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，难道，我不知道，也许是我这样想。

sentences.en: Don't we all?
sentences.zh: 难道我们不都这样想吗？

sentences.en: So, so what are you doing today to prepare for, for that day when unemployment benefits run out?
sentences.zh: 那么，那么你今天在做些什么来为失业救济金用完的那一天做准备呢？

sentences.en: Right now I am writing my bills as we speak.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻我正一边说话一边核算账单。

sentences.en: I'm writing my bills out.
sentences.zh: 我正在把账单列出来。

sentences.en: I'm writing down what I can cut.
sentences.zh: 我在写下哪些开支是可以削减的。

sentences.en: I'm looking and researching areas to live that we can move to and maybe get a livable wage and live safely.
sentences.zh: 我在寻找和研究我们可以搬去居住的地区，希望能赚到维持生计的薪水并且安全地生活。

sentences.en: I'm doing all of that.
sentences.zh: 我正在做所有这些事情。

sentences.en: You said you're, you're thinking about leaving North Carolina?
sentences.zh: 你刚才说你，你在考虑离开北卡罗来纳州？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm considering moving to another state if the opportunities are there for, for the dreams that I have for my family are there.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果那里有适合我和家人梦想的机会，我正在考虑搬到另一个州去。

sentences.en: I'm very open to that.
sentences.zh: 我对这一点非常持开放态度。

sentences.en: Moving to another state, yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 搬到另一个州，是的，绝对会考虑。

sentences.en: Do you remember a time when you didn't have to worry about money every day?
sentences.zh: 你还记得曾经有那么一段时间，你不用每天都为钱发愁吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不记得。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不记得。

sentences.en: Well, Nikita, I really appreciate your taking the time to talk to us and to share your story with, with all of us.
sentences.zh: 好吧，尼基塔，非常感谢你抽出时间跟我们交谈，并向我们所有人的分享你的故事。

sentences.en: And I, I hope that things work out for you soon.
sentences.zh: 我，我希望你的情况能很快好转。

sentences.en: I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you for taking the time, talking to me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽空跟我聊天。

sentences.en: Nikita has one week left on her state unemployment benefits.
sentences.zh: 尼基塔的州失业救济金只剩最后一周了。

sentences.en: Then she'll have to apply for an extension.
sentences.zh: 接下来她将不得不申请延期。

sentences.en: She's still getting the extra $600 a week from the federal government for now, but that runs out at the end of next month.
sentences.zh: 她目前仍然能从联邦政府获得每周额外的600美元，但那笔钱在下月底就会用完。

sentences.en: She's been looking for jobs, but with two kids at home, her options are more limited.
sentences.zh: 她一直在找工作，但由于家里有两个孩子，她的选择更加有限。

sentences.en: So she's really been looking to cut back financially.
sentences.zh: 所以她一直在极力缩减开支。

sentences.en: She told me she's thinking about getting rid of her car and she's planning for the future.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她正在考虑把车卖掉，并且正在为未来做打算。

sentences.en: She's wondering whether with her master's degree in criminal justice, she could get into professional counseling.
sentences.zh: 她纳闷凭着自己的刑事司法硕士学位，自己是否能从事专业心理咨询工作。

sentences.en: And she, she wrote me an email.
sentences.zh: 她，她给我发了一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: She said, I know I'll be able to bounce back.
sentences.zh: 她说，我知道我一定能东山再起。

sentences.en: I'm just not sure how long it will take or what sacrifices I will have to make.
sentences.zh: 我只是不确定需要花多长时间，或者我必须做出什么样的牺牲。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman, Ranking Member Walden.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，主席先生，资深成员沃尔登。

sentences.en: Thank you all for giving me the opportunity to discuss with you today the role of the National Institutes of Health and Research addressing COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家给我机会，今天与各位讨论国家卫生研究院和研究在应对新冠肺炎方面的作用。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, during an appearance before a House committee,
sentences.zh: 周二，在众议院委员会出席听证会期间，

sentences.en: Dr. Anthony Fauci warned that the next few weeks would be critical to confronting the dramatic surge of infections in states like Florida, Texas and Arizona.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·福奇博士警告称，接下来的几周对于应对佛罗里达州、得克萨斯州和亚利桑那州等地图呈爆发式增长的感染潮至关重要。

sentences.en: I've seen some data the last few days that while cases are going up in this country, deaths are going down.
sentences.zh: 我这几天看到一些数据，尽管这个国家的病例在上升，但死亡人数却在下降。

sentences.en: Should we see this as a positive sign or should we still be worried?
sentences.zh: 我们应该把这视为一个积极的信号，还是仍然应该感到担忧？

sentences.en: I think it's too early to make that kind of link, Congresswoman.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在做出这种联系还为时过早，国会女议员。

sentences.en: Let me explain.
sentences.zh: 让我解释一下。

sentences.en: Deaths always lag considerably behind cases.
sentences.zh: 死亡人数总是明显滞后于病例数。

sentences.en: During the hearing, Fauci cautioned that the current decline in deaths from the virus could quickly reverse and begin to climb again.
sentences.zh: 在听证会上，福奇警告称，目前病毒导致的死亡人数下降可能会迅速逆转并再次开始攀升。

sentences.en: So you're seeing more cases now while the deaths are going down.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在看到病例增多了，而死亡人数却在下降。

sentences.en: The concern is if those cases then infect people who wind up getting sick and go to the hospital, it is conceivable you may see the deaths going up.
sentences.zh: 令人担忧的是，如果这些病例随后传染给那些最终生病并住院的人，可以想象，你可能会看到死亡人数上升。

sentences.en: So I think it's too early to say because the deaths are going down.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得现在因为死亡人数下降就下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: Asked about the timing for a vaccine, Fauci said that he was optimistic that it could be ready by early next year.
sentences.zh: 当被问及疫苗的时间表时，福奇表示，他乐观地认为疫苗最早可能在明年年初准备就绪。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that as the European Union begins to lift travel restrictions next month,
sentences.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，随着欧盟下个月开始解除旅行限制，

sentences.en: it may block Americans from entering its 27 countries because of the failure of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 由于美国未能控制病毒的传播，欧盟可能会禁止美国人进入其27个成员国。

sentences.en: to control the spread of the virus.
sentences.zh: 美国控制病毒的失败导致了这一点。

sentences.en: Beside the U.S., the EU may also bar travel from Russia and Brazil.
sentences.zh: 除了美国，欧盟还可能禁止来自俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的旅客入境。

sentences.en: But it is likely to allow entry for citizens of China, where the pandemic began, but is now largely under control.
sentences.zh: 但它很可能会允许疫情爆发地、但目前已基本得到控制的中国公民入境。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正为筹备假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 请收听有关如何让客人在你家感到宾至如归的实用建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全然黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是爱喝咖啡还是爱喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
